statement: Establish one durable service-instance selection through the existing catalog/service-definition owner and carry original identity and resource custody through lifecycle, publication, recovery and WASM genesis; prove old-instance exclusion and valid current-instance progress without widening catalog activation or changing runtime ordering.

constraints.statement: Independent content-bound contract and oracle approval before production edits; test-only checkpoint before execution.
No main merge, F1 supersession, runtime drain/propose edit, request-Cell redirection, OCI activation, snapshot installer, timer/MG repair or full-release seal.
Preserve historical evidence; real owner creation outputs; meaningful same-profile mutations; locked lab first results; explicit snapshot and native versus component limits.
